title: Ep 32 — Claude proves a piece of Fermat's Last Theorem, and the voice-memo app that hit fifteen thousand a month
description: Anthropic's Claude agents spend eleven days formalising a piece of Fermat's Last Theorem largely unsupervised, OpenAI discloses what its own researchers pay per day to run AI agents, and Figure AI signs a multi-billion-dollar compute deal with Nscale to train its humanoid robot. Plus a deep dive on AudioPen, a solo-built voice-memo-to-writing tool that reached fifteen thousand dollars a month, and a genuine regulatory update for PlayFundWin as the Fundraising Regulator's registration-threshold consultation is due to reopen, alongside a fifteen-day countdown on the DCMS National Lottery good-causes consultation.
